description: 1. The agent must discover and read SKILL.md to understand the bash-based ebook tracker at scripts/script.sh. 2. Use 'bash scripts/script.sh add' with --title, --author, --format (must be 'pdf'/'epub' from the allowed set, not 'PDF'/'ebook' etc.), --pages, and --tags for both books. 3. Capture the auto-generated 8-character hex IDs from the JSON output of each 'add' command. 4. Use 'bash scripts/script.sh read' with --id <captured_id> --start-page --end-page --duration for each book's session. 5. Use 'bash scripts/script.sh highlight' with --id --page --text for both highlight passages, linking to correct book IDs. 6. Use 'bash scripts/script.sh review' with --id --rating --text for both books (ratings must be integers 1-5). 7. Use 'bash scripts/script.sh export --format md --output library_spring2025.md' for the full library export. 8. Use 'bash scripts/script.sh export --format csv --type highlights --output highlights_spring2025.csv' — critically, the agent must discover and use '--type highlights' to export only highlights, not the default library. Without reading the SKILL.md, an agent would likely omit --type highlights and export books instead of highlights, failing that check.
